summary: All three easy templates expose a perfect answer-bank-only shortcut. It survives delivery filtering and is reproduced in three stored generated questions. Package files remain unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Transform a first-order linear ODE into the exact derivative of y times an integrating factor; stop before solving for y.
reasoning_steps: Divide through by the leading coefficient if needed to identify P and Q in y'+Py=Q.
Integrate the elementary P and compute I=exp(integral P).
Multiply both sides by the same I and recognize I y'+I' y=(yI)'.
Choose the one equivalent transformed equation from a five-choice math radio bank.
invariants: The integrating factor must satisfy I'=P I and be nonzero on the stated domain.
The right side must be I times normalized Q, rather than the unnormalized original RHS.
Exactly one offered equation is valid, accounting for constant multiples of integrating factors.
Preserve elementary integration, product-rule reasoning, five radio choices and the stop at the transformed equation.
permitted_variations: Vary signed small constant P, including integer and simple fractional constants; the negative coefficient is answer-bearing, not fixed decoration.
Vary Q independently among observed elementary powers, trig and exponential functions, deriving all right sides consistently.
Vary whether a common x or x^2 leading factor needs division, within difficulty.
At moderate difficulty vary reciprocal coefficient and linear coefficient and their corresponding power/exponential integrating factors.

Vary which offered integrating factor qualifies and its position; hold most evidence fixed while changing P to make a different candidate qualify. No source supports fixing an option label or source-specific target.
Vary irrelevant display/order or a common nonzero leading scaling while preserving the normalized response.

source_replay.details: All eight supplied five-choice banks replay; all prompt prose and six available solution stage/prose masks match. Missing source keys/solutions, malformed historical distractor and supported sign/domain corrections are explicitly distinguished.

math.details: Independent symbolic parsing verifies prompts, unique valid choices, normalized right sides, final solutions and expanded multiplication rows for 21 raw test records, eight source replays and 16 delivered records.

variety.details: Signed coefficients, forcing and positions vary, but the same answer-producing bank role predicts 12/12 fresh easy answers, including 4/4 in each template. All 16 accepted delivery records retain it.

scope.details: Requested easy output retains constant-P integrating-factor transformation, five radio choices and source-comparable workload. All eight source families replay. Authored hard scope is outside this requested-easy delivery audit.

grading.details: Actual native learning::grade_field accepts 37 independently verified valid radio choices and rejects 148 distractors, including normalized delivered records. No free-entry fields are used; free-entry equivalence is inapplicable.

rendering.details: Unmodified actual UI renders all eight representative records successfully; all eight screenshots inspected, including controlled coefficient/shuffle pairs and complete worked solutions.

packaging.details: Exact manifest/runtime match: Python 3.13.5, SymPy 1.14.0 nested under packages. Deterministic replay, relocation through module and CLI, invalid parameters/field/level rejection pass. No assets or external output required; package hashes unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Relevant and irrelevant counterfactual dependencies pass, but the qualifying factor is always uniquely accompanied by its reciprocal and square. This bank-only cue bypasses reading P and Q; rejection, deduplication and positive-weight easy selection do not remove it.

findings.description: The authored constant-P bank is always [I, 1/I, I^2, x, x^2]. Without inspecting the ODE, select the exponential whose reciprocal and square are also offered (equivalently, choose the smaller-magnitude exponent among the two with the same sign). This gives the correct answer for every allowed nonzero a in all three easy templates. Observed successes: 12/12 fresh, 5/5 runner, 12/12 delivered fresh, 4/4 delivered runner. Three stored generated easy records reproduce exactly; affected-inventory.json identifies them.
findings.reproduction: Run /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python regression-shortcut.py from evidence_root; expected current exit 1. Minimal instance: generate("easy", seed=99017, template="signed_constant_power", parameters={"a":"1","n":3}). Prompt y prime+y=x^3; offered factors x,e^(2x),x^2,e^x,e^(-x). The bank alone singles out e^x. Complete record: minimal-failing-record.json. Native acceptance and rendered evidence: grader-report.json and render-counterfactual/question-001.png.
findings.requested_change: Change the family-wide authored easy bank-construction rule so the correct factor does not always occupy this unique reciprocal-and-square role. Vary which candidate qualifies using P while retaining valid complete banks, source method, five-choice response and difficulty; shuffling positions or changing a/Q is insufficient. Preserve the failing regression and add controlled cases where an unchanged candidate bank supports different correct factors as P changes, with native grading and subgroup shortcut checks.
